Question: Which estimator achieves the highest accuracy on the CLEVR validation set?
Evidence:
[E1] (text, Section Table 1, page 5): Table 1. CLEVR estimators results on CLEVR validation set EstimatorAPIoU=.50 Acc. Ins. seg. 99.0 Color 99.98 Material 99.97 Size 100
[E2] (text, Section 4.1, page 5): We trained a question-to-graph model for CLEVR (’None’-’Basic’, as denoted in Section 4.2.1 ), which generated 100% perfect graphs on its validation set. The visual estimators, described in Section 3.3.1 were also trained and provided the results given in Table 1 . CLEVR relations were estimated by simple rules using the objects’ coordinates.

claims.text: The estimator 'APIoU=.50' achieves the highest accuracy on the CLEVR validation set with an accuracy of 99.0% for instance segmentation.
The question-to-graph model generated 100% perfect graphs on its validation set.
